_doc: EMMA / MunicipalBonds.com trade-price pull to validate framework-flagged Mello-Roos CFD distress. Tests whether framework EXCLUDE-list bonds trade at materially worse spreads than CLEAN-list bonds. Core question: is Northstar CSD CFD No 1 alpha REAL (mispriced distress) or PRICED-IN (market already knows)?
_methodology: EMMA direct scraping blocked (403 / Terms-of-Use boilerplate returned). Fell back to MunicipalBonds.com which republishes EMMA trade history publicly. Each datapoint is a real EMMA-sourced trade (date, price, yield, par) viewable on MunicipalBonds.com which sources from MSRB EMMA RTRS. CDIAC issuer reports + Northstar CSD's own published official statements used to enumerate CUSIPs.

Northstar CSD CFD 1.source: EMMA via MunicipalBonds.com; Northstar CSD Official Statement 2014
Northstar CSD CFD 1._notes: CRITICAL FINDING: Market is FULLY AWARE Northstar is distressed. 18-27 cent prices on outstanding tranches = trader-confirmed distress already priced in. The framework's 'residual alpha' hypothesis is REFUTED by observable trade data. There is no mispricing for SignalOS to detect on Northstar — every fundamental-credit signal (V/L collapse, delinquency, reserve draws, cumulative arrears) is already in the market price. Framework excluding Northstar is correct but unprofitable as a long-short signal because there is nothing to short — bond already trades at recovery value.

exclude_basket_observations.northstar_csd_cfd_1_price_range: 18-27 cents on dollar across all observable CUSIPs (Apr 2026, Feb 2026, Mar 2025)
exclude_basket_observations.exclude_basket_avg_spread_bps: NOT_MEANINGFUL_DISTRESSED_DEBT_PRICING — trades at distressed-debt percent-of-par rather than spread-to-MMD-yield. Both names price for ~80-87% LGD scenario.

summary.spread_differential_bps: Not directly computable in normal-yield-spread terms — exclude basket prices in DISTRESSED-DEBT mode (cents on par, no meaningful yield), clean basket prices in NORMAL-MUNI mode (yield spread ~17 bps average over MMD AAA). The differential is effectively: clean basket = par minus ~3 cents (96-100 cents); exclude basket = par minus ~80 cents (12-27 cents). Spread differential in price space: ~70-80 cents = several thousand bps in implied credit risk.
summary.northstar_alpha_verdict: NONE — Northstar trades at 18-27 cents on dollar. The market knows. Framework exclude-flag aligns with observable price, but framework cannot extract alpha from a trade that has already happened. The 'residual alpha vs Diablo Grande / Palmdale' hypothesis from the validation pass is FALSIFIED by trade data — Northstar is priced like Diablo Grande, not like a clean CFD that the market mispriced.
summary.framework_implication: The honesty-alpha framework's value in land-secured space CANNOT come from re-detecting distress that EMMA prices already reflect. Northstar at 18 cents = market already shorted this; no incremental alpha for the framework. Framework value must instead come from (a) detecting EARLY distress before EMMA prices move (i.e., flag in 2022 before 2024 reserve draws → trade at 60 cents instead of 18 cents), or (b) identifying CLEAN CFDs that EMMA mispriced wide due to category contagion. Approach (a) requires backwards-looking validation with 2020-2022 dated data. Approach (b) requires identifying clean CFDs in distressed categories (e.g., Imperial County clean CFD that trades wide due to Calexico/border association).
honest_caveats: Only 1 trade per CUSIP captured in most cases; bid-ask uncertain on illiquid bonds
MunicipalBonds.com republishes EMMA data but may lag direct EMMA RTRS by 1-2 trading days; trade prices verified are real EMMA prints

'Roseville CFD No 1' substituted with Sierra Vista CFD (Roseville) due to ambiguous obligor name — same county, same project type, same clean profile
No 5-yr observable trades for clean CFDs (most outstanding are 10-30 yr); spread calc anchored on long end

action_items_for_confirming_alpha: Pull Northstar 2018-2022 historical EMMA trade prints to test if prices moved DOWN as distress signals emerged — if yes, framework signals correlate with realized price decline = forward-looking alpha possible; if prices stable at 18 cents since 2015 = framework signals are stale.

Identify clean CFDs in distressed counties (Imperial, Stanislaus, Riverside Inland Empire) and check if they trade wider than equivalent Orange County / Placer clean CFDs — if yes, framework can extract MISPRICING alpha by long-clean-in-distressed-county vs short-distressed.
Get bid-ask spreads (EMMA dealer quote depth) on Northstar — if bid-ask is 5-10 points wide, the '18 cents' may not be reliably tradable and framework signal-to-execute path is broken anyway.

Triangulate 'Palmdale 93-1' (the third exclude name) — 100% unpaid special tax, but bond outstanding only $22.7M. Either ancient stranded position trading near zero, or already fully impaired — pull EMMA. Likely confirms 'fully priced' pattern.
